notes.title: Update 0.1.2
notes.content:
Hey guys small update here!

There have been some small changes to the landscape in this update. Some slight rework in some areas. Swapped out some of the tree models which should provide some performance improvements. 

[previewyoutube=eROaqGrjhRc;full][/previewyoutube]


I have also changed up some of the town homes with ones that have interiors on them. They aren't enterable now but will be in a later update that will come along with the NPC update that is coming soon.

I have added an enemy spawner at the center of the map. The spawning book will act as the framework for testing out new enemy types that is going to be added in the next update. It will allow you to just jump right in and test new features as they come along.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757017/d5b9b9b860eb367c0a61b7a5aee76d06de887de8.gif


Some minor Changes:
-Increased the spawn rate of animals so that you will see more of them spread along the map
-Added random encounters along the map for the swordsman enemy type class
-Swordsman enemy now has a random loot drop chance
-Reworked some of the terrain to allow for easier sliding
-Added head relative rotation to the hip weapon slots

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
This is just a little update for now. Some People were having issues with the settings book when using non oculus devices,  I currently do not own another headset outside of my quest 2 so there might be some growing pains with non oculus users until I get my hands on some other devices. 

In the meantime I added a settings menu right at the start of the intro area so you don't have to go through anything if you need to change something right from the start. 

I also added a setting for a grab offset so you can control the angle of your grip of your weapon to suit your own preferences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757017/c6bf15c0699656e16cfb2c51f4ffd1285ccd24c1.gif


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757017/b57b04ec0931fc9aa335e5f66ce659b503219008.gif


Also while I work out the settings book to be easier to use for all devices I have made it so you can just throw the settings book on the ground and the settings menu will pop up for you to use instead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757017/b4d93f7e7bdd4244a1d517029ba8cb39899b68b8.gif


Some minor bug fixes:
-Fixed an issue with the collider for the lid on the treasure chests not being enabled
-Fixed and exploit where the player could get infinite money by spawning in items in the merchant shop and sliding them into the sell barrel ːsteamhappyː
